results.title: When will North Carolina's newest elected officials take office? Key dates
results.description: Democratic U.S. Senate candidate Roy Cooper thanks supporters as his wife, Kristin Cooper, looks on during an election night watch party at the Raleigh Marriott, Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026. Former Gov. Roy Cooper defeated Republican candidate Michael Whatley.
